To achieve a fit within uncertainty limits, an additional relative latitudinal motion is necessary during the
transition interval (1730–1650Ma). We suggest that a two-stage evolution occurred between Laurentia and

1800Mauntilca.1730Mainasemi-stableconfiguration.During1730–1650Ma,theyunderwentanetrelative
latitudinalmotion,leadingtothefinalassemblyofNunaafterca.1650Ma.
